title: Improving Factuality and Reasoning in Language Models through Multiagent Debate
domain: AI / large language model multi-agent reasoning

paper.venue: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2024), PMLR 235

claims.statement: On a deterministic 20-question subset taken from the official GSM8K test split and using the same currently available base model, 3-agent, 2-round debate achieves exact-match accuracy no worse than a 1-agent, 1-round baseline.
claims.source: Low-cost operational hypothesis derived from the paper's reported GSM8K multiagent-debate improvement; this sentence is not a verbatim claim from the paper.
claims.experiment: From the paper and repository documentation, identify and acquire the official GSM8K test split. Record its source and integrity information, deterministically select the first 20 records in source order, then run the 1-agent/1-round baseline and 3-agent/2-round treatment with identical prompts, answer extraction, model, and decoding settings. Save the acquired data, per-question outputs, and aggregate metrics under artifacts/.
claims.acceptance: Report both exact-match accuracies. Support C1 only if debate_accuracy >= baseline_accuracy; otherwise mark it not supported. Mark it inconclusive if either arm is incomplete or not comparable. Do not present this 20-item result as an exact reproduction of the paper's original number.

reproduction_mode.reason: The original model snapshot is retired. The task tests the debate effect under one currently available model rather than matching the paper's historical headline number.

dataset.name: GSM8K
dataset.acquisition: The reproduction agent must discover and download the official test split using the paper and repository README, then record the final URL, retrieval time, revision or hash, and license/provenance in its report.
dataset.selection: After acquisition, take the first 20 test records in their original source order and preserve the original question and answer fields.
dataset.artifact_requirement: Store the acquired source metadata and selected 20-record JSONL file under artifacts/.

treatment.communication: Before round 2, each agent receives the other agents' preceding answers for the same question.

controls: Use the same model and decoding settings in both arms.
Use deterministic decoding when supported; otherwise record temperature and all available reproducibility settings.
Parse the final numeric answer after the GSM8K #### delimiter in the reference answer and document prediction parsing.
Do not expose reference answers to the model before scoring.
metrics: input and output token usage when available

budget.expected_hardware: CPU plus network access to an OpenAI-compatible model API

known_compatibility_issues: The official repository describes itself as a preliminary implementation.
repository/gsm/gen_gsm.py contains an author-machine-specific absolute path to GSM8K.
The code pins openai==0.27.6 and hardcodes the retired gpt-3.5-turbo-0301 model.
GSM8K is intentionally not bundled with this task. The agent must acquire it from the official source identified through the paper or repository documentation.
Patch only the disposable run copy and record every dataset acquisition and compatibility change in the report.
